tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] You don't need a budget with twenty categories. You need a limit on one. || Most budgets die in week two. Tracking every coffee and every bus ticket turns into a second job, so you stop opening the spreadsheet, and the money leaks out anyway. || [turn] So do this instead. Open your bank app, scroll through last month, and add up the one category that leaks the most. For a lot of people, that's food delivery. || Say it came to two hundred and forty dollars. Set a cap of forty a week. Four weeks of forty is one sixty, so that's eighty dollars you keep, every month. || Then every Sunday, check one number. Under forty? That week is a win. Over? Don't quit. Next week starts again at zero. || It works for any leak. Clothes, games, coffee on the way to work. Just pick one, not five. || [land] Tonight, open your bank app, find your biggest leak, and write down your weekly cap. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.

scenes.head:
Not a budget.
A cap on one thing.

caption.instagram:
You don't need a budget with 20 categories. You need a limit on one.

1. Open your bank app, add up last month's biggest leak (often food delivery)
2. Set a weekly cap: $240/month → $40/week = $80 kept
3. Every Sunday, check one number. Over? Next week starts at $0
